title: Microsoft Visual Basic Enterprise Edition, Version 4.0 — CD-ROM disc label (flatbed scan, file media-disc01.png)

creator.depicted_work: Microsoft Corporation (disc label artwork and text; label reads "© 1991–1995 Microsoft Corporation. All rights reserved.")
creator.scan: Unknown individual scanner. Uploaded to the Internet Archive by the account displayed as "RetroGreekCollection"; the item page names no photographer/scanner and no creator field is set.

archive_item.description: Title only; no description, no license URL, no rights field.
files_not_downloaded: Disc01.iso (disk image; out of bounds for this ticket)

depicted_object_date: Disc printed code "0296" (Microsoft MMYY print code, read as February 1996 — inference, see claim-checks C4); copyright line 1991–1995. Item title date 1996-02-02 is the uploader's label and is not independently verified.
access_method: Anonymous HTTPS GET of the single image file (no account, no terms acceptance, no CAPTCHA). The disk image in the same item was not downloaded.

identity_evidence.medium: CD-ROM (single 120 mm optical disc; clear centre hub ring visible). Not a floppy set.
identity_evidence.bitness: Not printed on the disc label. The label says only "Designed for Windows 95" and "Programming System for Windows Platforms". Microsoft KB Q150423 lists Enterprise Edition 4.0 as both 16-bit and 32-bit products; which of those this disc installs cannot be read from the image, so no bitness is claimed.
identity_evidence.corroboration_same_item: cdcover-front.png reads "Microsoft Visual Basic Enterprise Edition" with the Designed for Windows 95 logo; cdcover-back.png spine reads "Microsoft Visual Basic, Enterprise Edition, Version 4.0" (0895 Part No. 64579); cdcover-inside.png refers to "the README.HLP file in the root directory of the Visual Basic CD" (0895 Part No. 64577). Jewel-case inserts carry 0895 codes while the disc carries 0296, so the inserts and disc may come from different print runs; the insert scans are not part of this delivery.

credit_text: Microsoft Visual Basic 4.0 Enterprise Edition CD-ROM (Microsoft Corporation, © 1991–1995). Scan: Internet Archive item "microsoft-visual-basic-4.0-enterprise-4.00.2422-1996-02-02-english-cd", uploaded by RetroGreekCollection. Rights not cleared.
